newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux traffic down three pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux traffic down three pct in Oct.

text.p: Cargolux Airlines International said it flew 187.8 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK), in October 1996, down three percent on the same month last year.
In the first 10 months of 1996, the airline flew a total of 1.64 billion FTK, an increase of four percent on 1995 levels, it said.
Cargolux operates a fleet of three Boeing 747-400Fs and three Boeing 747-200Fs as well as an additional 747-200F on leaseback.
Cargolux is due take delivery of a fourth 747-400F in August 1997.
